Furthermore, it was demonstrated that MDM2 amplification was associated with the overexpression of both RNA and proteins.
This amplification occurred mutually exclusively of p53 mutation.

In summary, these findings supported the developing hypothesis that high MDM2 expression through gene amplification represented an alternative mechanism to p53 mutation for inactivating the p53 signaling pathway and promoting tumor progression in sarcomas.
